name: org.aiimpacted/ledger
title: AIimpacted Verified AI Layoffs Ledger
description: Read-only verified ledger of job losses employers attributed to AI, with primary sources.

tools.name: get_totals
tools.description: Live totals of the AIimpacted ledger: verified events, employers, jobs, how many events disclosed no count, date span, and totals by year, industry and country. AIimpacted counts a job loss ONLY where the employer itself said AI or automation now does the work (regulatory filing, memo, earnings call, on-record statement). Reallocating spending toward AI is not counted. Events with no disclosed headcount have jobs_affected = null, never 0.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find verified events by employer name, industry, country or year (all optional, case-insensitive substring match on names). Each event has the employer, jobs (null = not disclosed), date, the employer's own words where recorded, the source document and the AIimpacted page.

company.description: Employer name or part of it, e.g. "Oracle"

industry.description: Industry name or part of it, e.g. "Banking"

year.description: Year of the event date, e.g. 2026

tools.name: recent_events
tools.description: The most recent verified events by event date, newest first.
